# Nuked-OPN2

Yamaha YM3438 / YM2612 emulator by Alexey Khokholov (Nuke.YKT), version 1.0.9, from
https://github.com/nukeykt/Nuked-OPN2 at commit 335747d78cb0abbc3b55b004e62dad9763140115
(2023-08-11). Licensed under the GNU Lesser General Public License 2.1 or later (LICENSE). The
files are as published; md-runtime uses them through `src/fm/nuked.c` only, so the core can be
swapped (`make FM_CORE=ymfm`) or relinked as the LGPL requires.
